Built on land.

We are preparing our first residential high-rise projects. Here is what we will carry with us.

Our next chapter

Twenty years of land taught us what makes a neighbourhood work. Now we are designing it in layers.

Since 2006 we have planned ten gated, plotted townships across Shamli, Meerut and Budhana — roads and utilities first, clear titles always. Our next projects take those same principles into residential high-rise communities in urban India.

What we will build

rise with the city
